offering_description.value: Processes and markets branded and private-label packaged meat, poultry, and prepared food products sold through retail grocers, foodservice operators, and other food businesses. It manufactures these products in its own plants and sells them under well-known brands.

primary_products.value: packaged meats; bacon; sausages; deli meats; canned meats; shelf-stable meals; refrigerated entrees; pet food

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery retailers, warehouse clubs, foodservice distributors, restaurant chains, food manufacturers; B2C: household consumers buying packaged foods at grocery and mass retailers

end_markets.value: retail grocery; foodservice; food manufacturing; pet food

revenue_model.value: product sales: packaged meat, poultry, and prepared food products sold to retailers and foodservice customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: processes raw hog, turkey, and chicken into packaged foods, sold to retailers and foodservice buyers; brand owner: owns and markets consumer brands sold through grocery and mass retail channels

geography_served.value: US national: Sells across the United States, with some exports and international sales to other countries

specialization.value: diversified: Multiple lines including Grocery Products, Refrigerated Foods, Jennie-O Turkey Store, and International, with different customers and channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams serving national grocery chains and foodservice accounts; distributors / dealers: foodservice distributors and wholesalers that resell to restaurants and institutions; third-party retail: grocery stores, warehouse clubs, and mass merchandisers selling to consumers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Food safety and labeling rules from USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service and FDA, plants require federal inspection and environmental rules apply
